research_snapshot.reported_mechanism: Clearance/Overstock page plus Open Box and closeout listing surfaces; links support ?storeid=### on site; enumerate *within a chosen store*, not nationwide.
research_snapshot.reported_extraction: Product SKU, model, retail vs open-box, grade, local in-store quantity and SKU-specific price. One-off open-box items separate.
research_snapshot.known_risks: Store-required price visibility (“just sign in” sometimes), pickup-only, grade variation and expired one-off items.
